title: Upload readings
purpose: Check a CSV file of temperature readings before anything is recorded.
summary: Check a CSV file of temperature readings before anything is recorded.

tasks.title: Check the file
steps: Choose the [[Equipment]] for rows that do not name it, or leave Named in the file.
Select [[Validate file]]. The import page shows the result.

tasks.title: Prepare the file
steps: Give measured_at and temperature_c on each row, and the equipment asset ID when the file covers several units.

good_to_know: A time without an offset is read in the repository's time zone.
Equipment and monitors are given by asset ID and must be registered and not retired.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators. Viewers are refused. Uploading only checks the file and saves the result: no reading exists until you commit the checked file on its page.

sections.title: The file
paragraphs: A UTF-8 CSV with a header row, up to 5 MiB and 10,000 data rows. A file over a limit, empty, not UTF-8, without the required columns, or with neither an equipment column nor a chosen Equipment is refused on this form and nothing is saved. Blank rows are skipped, extra columns are ignored with a warning, and row numbers in messages count the header as row 1.

items.label: measured_at
items.description: Required. ISO 8601 date and time, for example 2026-11-12T08:30. Without an offset the time is read in the repository's time zone. Not in the future.

items.label: temperature_c
items.description: Required. Degrees Celsius, up to two decimals, not below absolute zero.

items.label: equipment
items.description: Optional. The asset ID of the tank, freezer or other equipment read (for example TANK-VP-01). When blank, the Equipment chosen on this form is used. Monitors and retired equipment are refused.

items.label: probe_position
items.description: Optional, up to 80 characters (longer is cut).

items.label: device
items.description: Optional. The asset ID of the monitor that produced the reading (for example MON-01); must be a registered monitor that is not retired.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: Optional. Used for every row without an equipment value. Leave it on Named in the file when every row names its equipment.

sections.title: What the check does
paragraphs: Every row is checked against the register. A row is refused when the equipment or monitor is unknown, the time or value is invalid or in the future, the same equipment, time and probe position appears twice in the file, or a reading with that equipment, time and probe position is already recorded. Warnings do not block: readings outside the limits set on their equipment, and a file with exactly the same content that was committed before.
Validate file opens the result page whichever way the check went. A check expires 24 hours after it was made; after that upload the file again.
